# Function: unstable\_getAffinityId()

> **unstable\_getAffinityId**(): `string` \| `undefined`

Defined in: [packages/functions/src/affinity.ts:37](https://github.com/vercel/vercel/blob/main/packages/functions/src/affinity.ts#L37)

**`Experimental`**

Returns the affinity ID from the current invocation's
`x-vercel-affinity-id` header, or `undefined` when it is unavailable.

This is an experimental API and may change without notice.

## Returns

`string` \| `undefined`

## Example

```js
import { unstable_getAffinityId } from '@vercel/functions';

const affinityId = unstable_getAffinityId();
```
